info.name: eOffice Phase 1 — LOCAL SYNTHETIC smoke only (Task 22E)
info.description: DANGER: TEST-ONLY / NO REAL AUTH. Requires opt-in local listener on 127.0.0.1:8765. Headers choose in-memory fixtures, NOT government identity; never import into production. No real document network access or paid inference.

header.description: LOCAL TEST FIXTURE SELECTOR — NOT AUTHENTICATION

request.description: Local synthetic fixtures ONLY; 127.0.0.1; no real authentication, protected resources or AWS.

exec: pm.test("No protected URLs or synthetic diagnostics", function () { const s = pm.response.text(); ["private-alpha-secret","private-beta-secret","PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_"].forEach(x => pm.expect(s).not.to.include(x)); });

pm.test("Grounded reference", function () { const r=pm.response.json().references; pm.expect(r).to.be.an("array").with.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(r[0].document_id).to.eql("synthetic-policy"); pm.expect(r[0].title).to.eql("Synthetic Alpha Policy.pdf"); pm.expect(r[0].page_number).to.eql(2); });
